parts.label: c
parts.text:
The student looks from the position of the eye shown in Fig. 3.1, to observe the images of P1
and P2 through side CD of the block. He adjusts his line of sight until the images of P1 and P2
appear exactly one behind the other.
He places two pins P3 and P4 between side CD of the block and his eye so that P3, P4 and
the images of P1 and P2 seen through the block, appear exactly one behind the other.
The positions of P3 and P4 are shown on Fig. 3.1.
•
Draw a line through the positions of P3 and P4. Continue the line until it meets the normal
NL and label that point E.
•
Label the other end of the line F.
•
Measure the acute angle θ between EF and the normal. An acute angle is an angle less
than 90°.
